(5) Lucius doubles most things here (AS 10) and Lightning ignores Def, but he never got in range — use him earlier next map. (6) The thief escapes with chest loot if not killed by about turn 5.
- **Between chapters:** No save prompt appeared. Nothing was chosen. The boss kill ran straight into the Ch.8 title card; one Start from there landed on the Ch.8 Preparations screen.

## s11 — Ch.8 Vortex of Strategy (Lyn's tale, Hard) — WON on turn 16

- **Lost:** Nobody. Nils never touched. Closest call: Lyn baited the last fighter (Steel Axe) at (11,15) and took 15 of her 19 HP in one hit — she hit it once, not twice, and was left at 4.
- **Gained:** Lucius L3 -> L5 (20 HP, S8 R7) — he killed the mage, two cavaliers-worth of kills, both fighters, the boss (a 6% crit at range 2) and the last fighter. Florina L3 -> L4. Rath's bow broke on turn 2 (counter-killed the shaman with the last two uses), so Rath is WEAPONLESS and was a body for the rest of the map. Nothing dropped, no chests, the village at (13,3) was never visited.
- **What happened:** Objective "Defeat enemy" (rout), 14 enemies + 3 soldier reinforcements from the south edge (turns 3-4). The NW start pocket is walled by cliffs; only rows 4-7 cols 0-4 and the column-3 forest path lead south. Everything aggressive came to us: turn 2 Lucius killed the mage at range 2, Rath's counter killed the shaman; turn 3 Wil finished the merc, Lucius and Kent killed both cavaliers; turn 4 Lucius/Kent killed a soldier and the archer; turns 5-7 Kent baited and counter-killed the reinforcement soldiers one at a time (18x2 with a fresh Iron Lance, 100% vs Def 0). A fighter wandered from the village to a cliff pocket at (6,7) that only fliers reach; it walked out to (4,4) and Lucius killed it. The four SE enemies (boss, soldier, merc, fighter) were guards: soldier and merc walked onto the bridge at (8,14) once someone stood at (8,13) and died there; the fighter and boss never moved until baited. Boss (Lv6 Knight, 25 HP, Def 11, Steel Lance, at (12,15), 1-range): Lucius 10x2 from (10,15) — the second blow crit and killed him.
- **Army (Ch.9 start, game heals):** Lyn L6 19 HP, Mani Katti 25 (slot 0), Iron Sword 20, Vulnerary 2, Iron Axe 45. Kent L9 26 HP, Iron Lance 37 (slot 0), Iron Lance 1, Iron Sword 16, Iron Sword 46, NO vulnerary. Florina L4 19 HP, Slim Lance 15, Vulnerary 2, Door Key 1. Wil L5 22 HP, Iron Bow 24. Rath L8 26 HP, NO WEAPON, Vulnerary 3. Nils L1 14 HP. Lucius L5 20 HP, Lightning 24. Matthew L2 18 HP, Iron Sword 46, Lockpick 12 (deployed this chapter). Sain ghost still benched.
- **Learned:** (1) Lucius is the best unit on the team now: Lightning ignores Def, he doubles everything with AS<=6, and at range 2 nothing here counters — put him where a range-2 tile exists and forecast first. (2) ALWAYS forecast before a range-1 finish: Florina's "safe finisher" on a 7-HP merc was 5x1 at 63% against a 9-dmg, 98% counter. (3) Lyn as bait is not free: the Steel Axe fighter hit her for 15 at a displayed 23%; never bait the lord with anything that can do >half her HP. (4) fe7_threat's counts include guards that will never move; a guard at range 1 of your tile still attacks. (5) Cavalry cannot enter the row-4/5/6 cliffs or the (6,7)-(7,7) pocket; fe7_reachable before every cavalier move on this map. (6) The boss kill ran straight into the Ch.9 title card; one Start landed on the Preparations screen with a "Seize gate" objective and no save prompt.
- **Between chapters:** No prompts appeared. Nothing was chosen. Ch.9 has a Preparations screen.
- **Next:** Ch.9 A Grim Reunion, turn 0, Preparations screen up (objective "Seize gate"; press Start once to begin, then re-read fe7_state because slots re-sort). 8 deployed in the west: Lyn (1,8), Kent (2,6), Florina (2,11), Wil (0,9), Rath (3,7), Nils (3,6), Lucius (1,10), Matthew (2,10). 5 enemies: boss cls2A (30 HP, D10, weapons 0x1C and 0x28) at (17,13) with soldiers at (16,14) and (18,14); a cls0E (16 HP, Iron Sword) at (13,3); merc at (10,9). Wallace is expected to join on this chapter in the real game — watch for a green or new player unit. Rath has no weapon; Kent is the only vulnerary-less front-liner.
